integrity: The exact constrained optimizer is reconstructed from monotonicity of the two increasing fold terms against the decreasing fold term. Both candidate crossings are solved algebraically, their order is governed by a cubic with a unique root in (0,1), and the limiting quadratic coefficient is derived analytically. A standalone checker replays threshold, branch-equality, finite-grid, monotonicity, and asymptotic consistency checks; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a fixed-normalized-height optimization for parallelograms and does not extend the profile to arbitrary centrally symmetric convex bodies. It relies on the published corrected three-fold formula for parallelograms. Because the remaining optimization is elementary, equivalent unindexed prior observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact height profile for folding symmetry of parallelograms
